crash_back.risk_timing_policy: Declared RTS maneuver: first actual deceleration performs one stable native D100; repeated enabled and crossing a tactical boundary do not redraw; cancellation retains all original trials; a later distinct maneuver gets a new identity. This timing and cancellation policy is an explicit continuous-time adaptation, not a quoted source phase rule.
crash_back.scope: Source-bound v4 forward ship/submarine braking to zero, before physical movement; no automatic sustained astern. Quiet/coasting/heave-to/astern and damaged steering combinations require explicit ending or adjudication. Physical collision/ramming rules remain separate and incomplete.

astern.execution_scope: Opt-in v4 source navigation units: nonnegative speed and separate requested/actual reverse direction; brake through zero before changing direction; physical reverse swept-coast movement; single deployed source-bound sonar/VDS or actual towed ACM loss and independent Engineering critical. Reverse steering/casualties, multiple bodies, sweep gear and deployment/recovery cables preserve pending. Awaiting serialized joint validation, not chapter completion.
astern.risk_timing_policy: Explicit RTS: first actual successful reverse displacement per tick/180 window, then one originalD100 for each independent purpose; save and cache, no reroll on repeated order; no trial without an actual deployed body, for zero displacement or after swept coast rejects the segment.
astern.maximum_policy: First min(database capability with existing source damage/propulsion/depth caps, authored undamaged maximum, explicit surfaced-submarine cap). For surface astern halve that forward maximum; for submarine astern take min(forward maximum,5kt). Then independently min(source sea-state fraction times undamaged maximum, readiness and actual equipment limits). Do not multiply the weather fraction into a halved weather cap twice.
astern.critical_policy: Independent10% fouling uses the pre-check single deployed-body snapshot even when the50% body loss succeeds; root damage_runtime source Engineering critical, no ordinary hit/DP/BDA, no CrashBack fire exemption; original trials saved before unavailable metadata becomes pending.

turning.execution_scope: Standard rudder only; actual advance after order, swept per-leg terrain guard, actual pivot then speed loss; no banked old straight travel. Four45degree-equivalent loss budget per180s. Waterjet60-degree pivot uses next source size; no invented smaller-thanG row. Hard-rudder risk/unjam/critical steering not completed.

adaptations: Opt-in per-unit source/scenario propulsion fits; unknown CPP/waterjet/readiness/max speed is never inferred from class names.
The source acceleration limits per180-second Tactical Turn are distributed across continuous1-second movement; phase/impulse order is an explicit RTS adaptation.
Weather caps use undamaged maximum speed before damage/source equipment caps. Submerged submarines ignore sea-state caps; surfaced submarines use one size class larger.
Heave-to requires explicit wind direction and slows to the source3–5kt envelope. No unsupported timer or sinking probability is invented.
Underway dice produce exact seconds from printed fractions; do not round D10/3 or D6/3 to guessed whole turns.

Explicit RTS adaptation: submerged metre motion interpolates printed depth-band endpoints at printed bands/180s, with actual per-second speed and upper-bound fractional speed bracket. Surface/submerge and P-S/Shallow remain separate180s work; depth0 and surface speed are retained while submerging. Emergency Blow uses the next printed speed bracket, 31+ stays8; target and continuous minimum upward commitment are at least3 band coordinates. No zero-speed or VeryDeep rate is invented. Deep-to-surface/P-S requires Shallow first. CrashDive remains incomplete.

RTS normal turning: preserve complete printed advance before each pivot, split each1s path at the pivot point; non45degree final pivots and waterjet60degree pivots charge proportional printed45degree speed loss, capped at180degrees per Tactical Turn. This is declared movement adaptation, not a source partial-pivot rounding claim.
remaining: Standard-rudder advance/pivot speed loss is opt-in production scope; hard-rudder jamming/release and casualty steering source procedures remain incomplete.

Astern reverse steering/casualties, multiple-body selection, sweep-gear loss and deployment/recovery cable exposure remain pending. CrashBack source braking is a separately verified subset.
